## Generated client coverage

Measured by Deno against the generated REST client, not the Git host.

| lines     |   14587 / 14593 |   99.96% |
| branches  |           2 / 2 |  100.00% |

## Coverage boundaries

468 operations have a passing positive-response case (HTTP 2xx/3xx). 3 have negative-only checks:
expected errors, with no successful-response test. Endpoint coverage does not prove every successful
API behavior or server implementation path.

- `getSigningKeySSH`
- `repoGetNote`
- `repoSigningKeySSH`
